acceptance_evidence: unittest discover green (incl. new EvidenceRelatives tests); validate_shiki green; live: the loop's impl PR validates + auto-merges.
completion_conditions: _evidence_relatives_for_task adds .shiki/goals/<goal>.json + .shiki/locks/<task>.json always, and .shiki/dag/<goal>.json only when its node set is the synced task; tests + validate green.
non_goals: No change to the loop's completion semantics (Gap B / pushing goal-complete to main is separate).
No multi-task DAG sync (guarded off to avoid validate_dag node-mismatch).
outcome: The autonomous loop's task PR is self-contained for a locally-started goal: _evidence_relatives_for_task carries the goal file, this task's lock, and (for a single-task goal) the DAG onto the branch, so validate_shiki passes on the PR HEAD instead of failing 'goal_id has no matching goal file' — letting the loop auto-merge the impl PR.
title: Repair: loop must sync goal/dag/lock to the task branch (Gap A; #140 T5 self-drive)
